newsitem.title: CROATIA: Maglite mogul backs waste plant on Croatian isle.
newsitem.headline: Maglite mogul backs waste plant on Croatian isle.

text.p: The inventor of Maglite torches, Anthony Maglica, has donated a $150,000 generator for a waste incinerator to be built on the Croatian island of Zlarin, the local daily Vjesnik reported on Tuesday.
The California-based mogul's parents were born on the picturesque island in the Adriatic but emigrated many years ago.
Two other Croatian expatriates are also sponsoring the incinerator, Vjesnik said.
Maglica was also considering investments to revive traditional Zlarin trades, such as processing of coral and sponge, and to promote them on the international market.
He was also reported to be interested in opening a plant to produce electric light bulbs in the region.
